mentions.name: Home phone media backup box
mentions.description: This home-oriented hardware box with accompanying software backs up media files from phones. It supports a primary data drive inside the box plus a separate backup drive (stored in a closet) for redundancy.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a home-oriented solution (hardware box + software) for backups of the media files from phones.
